meanings.usage: 指位于欧洲、亚洲和非洲之间的海域，也可用作形容词
强调动作或状态的持续性，常带有令人不快的含义
用于形容寒冷或情感强度
指因意外或不快的事情而产生的强烈惊讶
指承受痛苦、困难或不愉快的事情

meanings.meaning: complain to sb. 向某人抱怨

meanings.usage: 表示时间上的即刻或毫无延迟
指回到原来所在的地方或状态
作名词指美好的愿望或幻想；作动词指做梦或梦想
用于排除某个或某些事物

phrases.usage: 指在某地安顿下来，长期居住

examples.en: He planned to settle down in the country.
examples.zh: 他计划在这个国家安顿下来。

phrases.usage: 表示一...就...，用于描述两个紧接着发生的动作

examples.en: He had no sooner returned than he bought a house.
examples.zh: 他一回来就买了一栋房子。

phrases.usage: 表示超过某人能忍受的限度

examples.en: In the end, it was more than he could bear.
examples.zh: 最后，他实在无法忍受了。

phrases.usage: 表示刚...就...，hardly后用过去完成时

examples.en: He had hardly had time to settle down when he sold the house.
examples.zh: 他还没来得及安顿下来就把房子卖了。

examples.en: He had often dreamed of retiring in England.
examples.zh: 他经常梦想在英国退休。

examples.en: Almost immediately he began to complain about the weather.
examples.zh: 几乎立刻他就开始抱怨天气。

phrases.usage: 表示好像、似乎，引导方式状语从句

examples.en: He acted as if he had never lived in England before.
examples.zh: 他的表现就好像他从未在英国住过一样。

examples.en: In the end, it was more than he could bear.
examples.zh: 最后，他实在无法忍受了。

examples.en: He sold the house and left the country.
examples.zh: 他把房子卖了，离开了这个国家。

phrases.usage: /ˈsetl daʊn/ verb phrase. 定居；安顿下来（指在某地长期居住或安定下来）

grammar.title: no sooner...than... 句型
grammar.structure: 主语 + had no sooner + 过去分词 + than + 主语 + 过去式
grammar.definition: 表示'一...就...'，用于强调两个紧接着发生的动作 用于描述某个动作刚完成，另一个动作立即发生。than后的从句用一般过去时

examples.en: He had no sooner returned than he bought a house.
examples.zh: 他一回来就买了一栋房子。

examples.en: She had no sooner arrived than she called me.
examples.zh: 她一到就给我打电话了。

grammar.title: hardly...when... 句型
grammar.structure: 主语 + had hardly + 过去分词 + when + 主语 + 过去式
grammar.definition: 表示'刚...就...'，用法与no sooner...than...相似 hardly位于句首时，主语和助动词要倒装。when引导的从句用一般过去时

examples.en: He had hardly had time to settle down when he sold the house.
examples.zh: 他还没来得及安顿下来就把房子卖了。

examples.en: Hardly had I sat down when the phone rang.

grammar.title: as if/though 虚拟语气
grammar.structure: 主语 + 动词 + as if/though + 主语 + had + 过去分词...
grammar.definition: 在as if/though引导的状语从句中，若表示与事实相反或不太可能发生的事，用虚拟语气 当描述的情况与事实相反时，从句谓语用过去完成时表示对过去的虚拟

examples.en: He acted as if he had never lived in England before.
examples.zh: 他的表现就好像他从未在英国住过一样。

examples.en: She talks as if she knew everything.
examples.zh: 她说话的样子就好像她什么都知道似的。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + had no sooner + 过去分词 + than + 主语 + 过去式

original.en: He had no sooner returned than he bought a house.
original.zh: 他一回来就买了一栋房子。

imitations.en: I had no sooner left home than it started to rain.

patterns.pattern: 主语 + had hardly + 过去分词 + when + 主语 + 过去式

original.en: He had hardly had time to settle down when he sold the house.
original.zh: 他还没来得及安顿下来就把房子卖了。

imitations.en: She had hardly finished eating when the guests arrived.
imitations.zh: 她刚吃完饭客人就来了。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + acted as if/though + 主语 + had + 过去分词...

original.en: He acted as if he had never lived in England before.
original.zh: 他的表现就好像他从未在英国住过一样。

imitations.en: She looked as if she had seen a ghost.
imitations.zh: 她看起来好像见了鬼一样。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + had often dreamed of + 动名词/名词

original.en: He had often dreamed of retiring in England.
original.zh: 他经常梦想在英国退休。

imitations.en: I have dreamed of traveling around the world.
imitations.zh: 我一直梦想着环游世界。

lines.en: My old friend, Harrison, had lived in the Mediterranean for many years before he returned to England.
lines.zh: 我的老朋友哈里森在回到英国以前曾多年居住在地中海地区。

lines.en: He had often dreamed of retiring in England and had planned to settle down in the country.
lines.zh: 过去他常幻想退休后到英国，并计划在乡间安顿下来。

lines.en: He had no sooner returned than he bought a house and went to live there.
lines.zh: 他刚一回到英国便买下了一幢房子住了进去。

lines.en: Almost immediately he began to complain about the weather, for even though it was still summer, it rained continually and it was often bitterly cold.
lines.zh: 但紧接着他就开始抱怨那里的天气了。

lines.en: After so many years of sunshine, Harrison got a shock.
lines.zh: 因为即使那时仍为夏季，但雨总是下个不停，而且常常冷得厉害。

lines.en: He acted as if he had never lived in England before.
lines.zh: 在阳光下生活了那么多年的哈里森对此感到惊奇。

lines.en: In the end, it was more than he could bear.
lines.zh: 他的举动就好像他从未在英国生活过一样。

lines.en: He had hardly had time to settle down when he sold the house and left the country.
lines.zh: 最后，他再也忍受不住，还没等安顿下来就卖掉了房子，离开了这个国家。

lines.en: The dream he had had for so many years ended there.
lines.zh: 他多年来的幻想从此破灭。

lines.en: Harrison had thought of everything except the weather.
lines.zh: 哈里森把每件事情都考虑到了，唯独没想到天气。

questions.q: Why did Harrison sell his house so quickly?
questions.zh: 哈里森为什么这么快就卖掉了房子？
questions.a: Because he could not bear the English weather. Even though it was still summer, it rained continually and it was often bitterly cold, so hardly had he had time to settle down when he sold the house and left the country.
questions.aZh: 因为他忍受不了英国的天气：尽管仍是夏天，雨却下个不停，而且常常冷得刺骨，所以他还没安顿下来就卖掉房子离开了。
questions.hint: 见 In the end, it was more than he could bear.

questions.q: Where had Harrison lived before he returned to England, and what had he planned to do?
questions.zh: 哈里森回英国前住在哪里？他原本计划做什么？
questions.a: He had lived in the Mediterranean for many years. He had often dreamed of retiring in England and had planned to settle down in the country.
questions.aZh: 他在地中海地区生活了多年；他常幻想在英国退休，并计划在乡间安顿下来。

questions.q: What shocked Harrison after his return, and how did he behave?
questions.zh: 回国后什么让哈里森震惊？他的举止如何？
questions.a: After so many years of sunshine, Harrison got a shock: it rained continually and it was often bitterly cold. He acted as if he had never lived in England before.
questions.aZh: 在阳光下过了那么多年的他大受打击；他的举止就好像从未在英国生活过一样。
questions.hint: as if 后接过去完成时表示与过去事实相反。

questions.q: Put the two sentences containing no sooner ... than and hardly ... into the inverted order.
questions.zh: 把含 no sooner ... than 和 hardly ... when 的两句改成倒装语序。
questions.a: No sooner had he returned than he bought a house and went to live there. / Hardly had he had time to settle down when he sold the house and left the country.
questions.aZh: 他刚一回到英国便买下房子住了进去；他还没等安顿下来就卖掉房子离开了这个国家。
questions.hint: 助动词 had 提到主语前。

questions.q: What is ironic about the title 'Everything except the weather'?
questions.zh: 标题“唯独没有考虑到天气”的讽刺意味在哪里？
questions.a: Harrison had thought of everything except the weather: the money, the house and the place to settle down. The one thing he forgot was the most ordinary thing he could not escape, and it destroyed his lifelong dream.
questions.aZh: 他把一切都想到了，唯独漏掉了最平常却躲不开的天气；正是这个疏漏终结了他多年的梦想。
questions.hint: 结合末句 Harrison had thought of everything except the weather。

translation:
我的老朋友哈里森在回到英国以前曾多年居住在地中海地区。
过去他常幻想退休后到英国，并计划在乡间安顿下来。
他刚一回到英国便买下了一幢房子住了进去。
但紧接着他就开始抱怨那里的天气了。
因为即使那时仍为夏季，但雨总是下个不停，而且常常冷得厉害。
在阳光下生活了那么多年的哈里森对此感到惊奇。
他的举动就好像他从未在英国生活过一样。
最后，他再也忍受不住，还没等安顿下来就卖掉了房子，离开了这个国家。
他多年来的幻想从此破灭。
哈里森把每件事情都考虑到了，唯独没想到天气。
title: Everything except the weather
subtitle: 唯独没有考虑到天气

lead.question: 盼了多年终于回英国养老的哈里森，为什么很快就把新买的房子卖掉了？
lead.warmup: 设想你在阳光充足的地中海生活了大半辈子，天天梦想回英国乡间养老，一切都盘算好了，唯独忘了一件小事——英国的天气。哈里森正是如此：他刚回国就买房定居，却在同一年夏天遇上连绵阴雨和刺骨寒冷，多年的梦想还没落地就碎了。
goals: 掌握 no sooner ... than 与 hardly ... when 的搭配及句首倒装语序
用过去完成时理清“回国前的打算”与“回国后的行动”的先后
学会 dream of、settle down、complain about、think of 等本课短语
辨析 continually / continuously 以及 country / countryside
lead.summary: 哈里森在地中海生活多年，一直梦想回英国退休、在乡间安顿。他一回国就买了房子，可当年夏天雨下个不停、天气刺骨地冷，他大受打击，举止仿佛从未在英国生活过。最后他忍无可忍，还没安顿好就卖房离去。文中过去完成时交代“回国前”的打算，两组倒装连词把买房与卖房压缩在一瞬。
lead.tips: no sooner 后必须接 than、hardly 后必须接 when，不可混用；置于句首时助动词 had 要提到主语前；过去完成时不能与 ago 连用。

exercises.q: 用 no sooner ... than 合并两句，并把 no sooner 置于句首：He returned to England. He bought a house at once.
exercises.a: No sooner had he returned than he bought a house.
exercises.note: no sooner 在句首要倒装，后接 than。

exercises.q: 用 hardly ... when 合并两句，并把 hardly 置于句首：He had time to settle down. Then he sold the house and left the country.
exercises.a: Hardly had he had time to settle down when he sold the house and left the country.

exercises.q: 用所给动词的正确时态填空：Harrison ______ (live) in the Mediterranean for many years before he ______ (return) to England.
exercises.note: 先发生的动作用过去完成时。

exercises.q: 填空：He had often dreamed of ______ (retire) in England and settling down in the country.
选词填空（continually / continuously）：It rained ______ and it was often bitterly cold.
汉译英：在阳光下生活了那么多年后，哈里森开始抱怨天气——雨总是下个不停，而且常常冷得刺骨。
exercises.a: After so many years of sunshine, Harrison began to complain about the weather, for it rained continually and it was often bitterly cold.

exercises.q: 改错：He had thought everything except the weather.
exercises.a: He had thought of everything except the weather.
exercises.note: think of 不可漏掉 of。

quiz.q: 哈里森回到英国之前，在哪里生活了很多年？
options: in the Mediterranean
in the countryside of England
in a big city in France
in the north of England

quiz.q: 哈里森回国后原本打算做什么？
options: settle down in the country
look for a job in London
travel around the world
buy a farm in the Mediterranean

quiz.q: 下列哪一句正确表达了“他刚一回来就买了房子”？
options: No sooner had he returned than he bought a house.
No sooner he had returned when he bought a house.
Hardly had he returned than he bought a house.
No sooner had he returned when he bought a house.
quiz.note: no sooner 配 than，置于句首须倒装。

quiz.q: 课文描写雨下个不停用的是哪一句？
options: It rained continually.
It rained continuously.
It rained continuously for twenty hours.
It hardly rained at all.

quiz.q: 哈里森为什么会 got a shock？
options: After years of sunshine, he found the English weather unbearable.
He found the house too expensive.
He lost his job in England.
He could not find his old friends.
quiz.note: 见 After so many years of sunshine, Harrison got a shock。

quiz.q: 标题 Everything except the weather 指的是什么？
options: He had thought of everything except the weather.
He liked everything about England.
He forgot everything about the Mediterranean.
The weather was the only thing he enjoyed.
